bio.text: Michael R. Benedetto represents Assembly District 82 and was first elected to the Assembly in 2004, according to his official biography.
He was born in the Bronx in 1947, has lived in the Northeast Bronx his whole life, and graduated from Iona College in 1969 with a B.A. in history and education.
Before the Assembly he spent 35 years teaching, and for almost 28 of them he was at P.S. 160 in Co-op City.
